data.title: Ethereum Foundation sued after firing employee over mandatory 'Source Seppuku' suicide pact — non-profit crypto firm demanded employees pledge to take their own lives with a sword to protect open-source code, founder Vitalik Buterin claims bizarre 1,000-year mandate was just artwork
data.description: A former employee of The Ethereum Foundation is suing the nonprofit after being fired for refusing to sign its 'Source Seppuku License.'
